message.content:
The most commonly cited figure for California’s residential real‑estate market is the **median home price** (the middle value when all home prices are sorted). According to Zillow’s “California Home Value Index” (latest data from Q4 2023), the median home price in California is **about $800,000**.  

If you’re looking for an *average* (mean) price rather than the median, the mean tends to be higher because a few very expensive properties pull the average up. Zillow’s mean home value for California in the same period was roughly **$1.0 million**.  

| Metric | Value (Q4 2023) | Source |
|--------|----------------|--------|
| Median home price | ≈ $800,000 | Zillow, California Home Value Index |
| Mean (average) home price | ≈ $1,000,000 | Zillow, California Home Value Index |

These figures are rounded and reflect the overall market; local variations can be substantial (e.g., San Francisco and Los Angeles are well above the state average, while rural areas are below).
